_comment: Allowlist of UNCONDITIONAL pytest skips (audit F019). Every @pytest.mark.skip / module-level `pytestmark = pytest.mark.skip` with no condition must appear here with a category and reason. test_permanent_skip_allowlist_guard.py fails on any skip that is NOT listed (a new permanent skip) and on any listed key that no longer exists (stale entry) — shrink-only. Conditional skips (pytest.skip() gated on missing infra, skipif) are NOT tracked here. Categories: 'dead' = code removed/moved, delete the test; 'coverage-gap' = real behaviour left untested (restore); 'tech-debt' = test needs a mocking/logic fix; 'perf' = unstable perf baseline (see F028).
